source_title: SNEAKO X Professor Jiang X Dave Smith | Unity Amidst Chaos - Full Panel Discussion
summary: This April 15, 2026 Sneako panel is a high-pressure routing source for imperial-decline war causation, petrodollar and Treasury addiction, boomer sacrifice refusal, Canada as authoritarian warning, elite-school formation, and the First Amendment as the remaining American correction channel.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang says he makes predictions to validate theoretical models of how the world works and uses debate to doubt and test those models.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Prediction owns the method discipline: model testing, doubt, debate, later status, and correction. This source strengthens that public method but does not need a new prediction-method page.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang says America is addicted to the petrodollar, money printing, and global Treasury demand, which finance an unusually privileged American lifestyle.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Power As Alchemy owns the conversion of dollar protection and Treasury demand into lived economic reality; Dollar Hegemony owns the full operating system.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The source restates reserve privilege as addiction: the United States needs the world to keep buying Treasuries so ordinary American consumption can remain materially easier than the underlying economy warrants.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The active mechanism is reserve-demand addiction and forced demand, not a new petrodollar page.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang turns imperial decline into a generational sacrifice test: boomers hold wealth and political power, refuse a hypothetical sacrifice for peace and descendants, and remain the demographic backing the Iran war.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Gerontocracy owns old-age extraction, empire as old-age habitat, and the young or descendants as the payment surface. Prediction owns the dated authoritarian-exit forecast.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang uses Canadian trucker debanking and broader Canadian politics as a warning that access control can precede overt police authoritarianism.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Mass Society owns bank access, digital permission, and administrative control when the active object is population governance; Gerontocracy owns Canada's asset and boomer layer.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang describes Yale formation as producing a programmed liberal reflex and elite schools as graduating people trained to please authority and justify means by ends.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Education owns school as soul formation. The source adds elite-political formation evidence, but it does not require a new Yale, Democratic elite, or programmed-liberal page.

new_lens_seeds.title: Boomer Sacrifice Test
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A declining empire can know what peace or renewal would require and still fail because the wealthiest old cohort treats short remaining comfort as more real than descendants, allies, or the future polity.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The test joins imperial privilege, petrodollar comfort, generational wealth, Iran-war support, and authoritarian hardening into one diagnostic for whether an empire can voluntarily shrink.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as a seed. Gerontocracy already has the parent mechanism; promote only if later clustered sources need a narrower hover or a public replacement paragraph.

new_lens_seeds.title: First Amendment As Correction Channel
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Free speech is treated not as abstract liberal ornament but as the remaining institutional condition for model correction, cross-faction conversation, and lowering political temperature before violence or censorship closes the loop.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The source gives three adjacent scenes: Jiang wants cross-ideological conversation, prediction needs public debate, and the closing panel treats broad platforming as the only way to keep disagreement talkable.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as a seed until other sources show the same speech-as-correction mechanism. Do not create a generic free-speech page from one panel.
